source_semantics: ReloadAsync performs a read-only authoritative maintenance snapshot using the currently selected older-than-days and keep-latest policy values.
The top-level Refresh control is a distinct canonical operation from RefreshPreviewAsync while both use the same source snapshot behavior.
Laravel returns the same tenant-scoped storage and cleanup-preview snapshot through the existing SiteOperationHistoryService read runtime.
Both maintenance refresh controls share one busy boundary so concurrent reload/preview requests cannot race through the UI.
The existing maintenance snapshot path is reused rather than introducing a competing maintenance architecture.
The response is bound to AIMW-AI-CAAC427FC0 and the selected policy; AIMW-AI-C5BC29CF27 remains a separate terminal operation.
security: caller cannot supply site, history, cleanup, or retention mutation identifiers
older_than_days and keep_latest are allowlisted to the authoritative source choices and invalid values fail with validation errors
reload transport is GET-only and does not call cleanup or clear operations
frontend rejects cross-origin reload destinations, mismatched canonical operation identity, and mismatched policy responses
